description: This source file defines a SwiftUI view named `VoiceWakeSettings` for configuring voice wake features in a macOS app. It includes UI components for toggles, pickers, trigger words, sound settings, and live microphone level monitoring, along with associated logic for managing microphone input, locales, testing voice commands, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: VoiceWakeSettings
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view for configuring voice wake options, including toggles, microphone and locale selection, trigger words, sound settings, and live microphone level monitoring.

classes.name: AudioInputDevice
classes.description: Struct representing an audio input device with UID and name.

classes.name: TriggerEntry
classes.description: Struct representing a trigger word entry with an ID and value.

methods.name: loadTriggerEntries
methods.description: Synchronizes trigger words from app state to local trigger entries.

methods.name: syncTriggerEntriesToState
methods.description: Updates app state with current trigger words from local entries.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds a new empty trigger word entry.

methods.name: removeWord
methods.description: Removes a trigger word entry by ID.

methods.name: toggleTest
methods.description: Starts or stops the voice wake test, managing the tester and timeout tasks.

methods.name: chimeRow
methods.description: Builds a UI row for selecting and playing a chime sound.

methods.name: chooseCustomChime
methods.description: Opens a file dialog to select a custom chime sound.

methods.name: selectChime
methods.description: Sets the chime selection and plays it.

methods.name: sanitizedTriggers
methods.description: Returns sanitized list of trigger words.

methods.name: textOnlyCommand
methods.description: Parses text transcript to extract command based on triggers.

methods.name: loadMicsIfNeeded
methods.description: Discovers available microphones and updates the list.

methods.name: updateSelectedMicName
methods.description: Updates the app state with the name of the selected microphone.

methods.name: scheduleMicRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a refresh of microphone list and restart of meter.

methods.name: friendlyName
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a locale.
